text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + client timeouts on /v1/generate after canary rollout. p95 jumped ~1.4s (baseline ~120ms), p99 ~6.2s. 5xx rate 3.8% over last 1m. Canary id=canary-2026-03-17-12:06:45

maria-oncall: ack, paging SREs. I'm oncall.

david-sre: ack, looking at dashboards and traces now.

isha-eng: I pushed that canary. The only change was connection pooling/keepalive tuning and new HTTP/2 multiplex code.

david-sre: traces show lots of stalled downstream connections to model-backend on canary hosts. TCP stats show increased TIME_WAIT and queue length. Looks like keepalive exhaustion -> backlog -> request timeouts.

maria-oncall: Is this limited to canary or global?

david-sre: Metrics: CPU and GPU fine. Error spike co-located with canary nodes and started at rollout time. Non-canary hosts stable.

carla-cs: CS is getting reports — 2 large customers saw elevated 502/504 on ingestion routes in EU. They're asking if it's a deploy.

maria-oncall: Ok. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) rollback canary, 2) scale up stable host pool, 3) notify CS. Any objections?

isha-eng: +1 to rollback. I'll stand by to run a safe revert if SRE wants.

david-sre: I'll trigger rollback and hold. Running: `ops rollback canary-2026-03-17-12:06:45`

deploy-bot: Rollback command accepted: ops rollback canary-2026-03-17-12:06:45 by david-sre. Initiating traffic shift.

observability-bot: Canary traffic diverted. p95/p99 metrics for /v1/generate starting to fall — 1m window showing drop from 1.4s -> 180ms. 5xx rate trending down.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. canary group reverted to v1.28.6. Health checks: 32/32 passing.

maria-oncall: Confirming customer-facing errors dropping. Carla, can CS confirm if reports have stopped?

carla-cs: CS: customers reported improvement ~2m after rollback. They're happy with the rollback. Told them root cause being investigated; opened incident ticket INC-2026-0421.

devops-bot: Temporary mitigation applied: increased stable pool by +2 nodes, disabled the new keepalive tuning on canary hosts.

david-sre: Quick notes: root symptom appears to be connection/keepalive change + HTTP/2 multiplexing edge case causing head-of-line stalls under bursty traffic. We'll collect tcpdump/logs for deeper analysis.

isha-eng: I'll hold the feature branch and add a reproduction test for multiplex + connection limits.

maria-oncall: Good. Next steps: SRE to collect traces & tcpdumps, ENG to add test and revert PR permanently if needed, CS to notify affected customers with timeline. Postmortem owner: @isha-eng.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421. Priority: P1 -> oncall handoff protocol initiated.

david-sre: uploading packet captures and flame graphs to the incident doc now: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0421>

carla-cs: I'll follow up with customers with rollback & mitigation summary.

maria-oncall: Thanks all. Stand down from pager once logs/metrics show stable for 15m.

observability-bot: 15m health window started. If metrics stay within SLO, we'll close the oncall escalation.

isha-eng: taking postmortem ownership. I'll coordinate with SRE on logs and schedule a rollback-retrospective.

maria-oncall: closing loop: rollback successful, customer impact reduced, oncall monitoring for next 30m. :white_check_mark:
